# Gene Roth Advisory, LLC

> AI-assisted compliance advisory for airports, DBEs/ACDBEs, consultants, and concession and construction primes, led by a former FAA compliance director.

Gene Roth Advisory, LLC is an Atlanta-based regulatory compliance and advisory firm founded by a former FAA Director of National External Operations, Policy and Compliance Programs. The site is a single page; the links below point to its main sections and resources.

## Services

- [Advisory & Consulting](https://generoth.com/#services): fractional chief of staff, business development, DBE/ACDBE program advisory, Title VI and ADA / Section 504 compliance programs, and regulatory program design.
- [AI-Powered Compliance Tools](https://generoth.com/#services): compliance audit agents, a RAG-based DBE/ACDBE narrative builder, certification deadline and IFR recertification tracking, and regulatory change detection.
- [Data & Analytics](https://generoth.com/#services): airport operational performance, airline passenger experience, environmental compliance, and certification-rate analytics built on federal datasets (7M+ BTS flight records).
- [AI & Technology Services](https://generoth.com/#services): custom compliance SaaS, agentic AI workflow design, RAG system architecture, and LLM integration.

## Portfolio

- [Live AI tools](https://generoth.com/#portfolio): eight production compliance and analytics tools built on federal data.

## Key expertise

DBE certification, ACDBE certification, 49 CFR Part 26, 49 CFR Part 23, Title VI compliance, ADA / Section 504 accessibility, FAA airport compliance, AI compliance tools, and RAG systems.
